description: Personal Codex bundle of the 13 official Taste frontend design and image-reference skills.

interface.shortDescription: Build distinctive interfaces and design references.
interface.longDescription: Personal Codex bundle of the 13 official Taste frontend design and image-reference skills. Contains the upstream default v2 experimental skill and the separately named v1 compatibility skill. Individual skills are selected according to the task. The optional Stitch-specific skill does not install or connect Google Stitch. This local wrapper is not an official published Codex plugin. The upstream distribution does not include an MCP server.
